source.base_subject: docs: record Decode gate-up balanced-tail rejection

profile_priority.reason_selected: the fused exact-M1 NVFP4 gate/up kernel is the largest Decode hotspot and its canonical four-row loads expose a bounded packed-weight latency-overlap experiment

candidate.scope: test-only exact M1 residual/norm/gate/up/SiLU kernel; never selected by production dispatch
candidate.loader_mapping: copy_row=lane/8 and vector_in_row=lane%8; each lane copies one aligned uint4 from one canonical row
candidate.consumer_mapping: after wait and warp synchronization, compute lane c loads shared uint32 words c, 32+c, 64+c, and 96+c for its four rows
candidate.pipeline: one shared slot plus current packed words in registers; after all four words are registerized and a second warp synchronization completes, the next K256 tile overwrites the slot while current FFMA chains execute
candidate.runtime_double_or_triple_buffer: logical register/shared double buffering only; no second shared slot and no executor-level overlap
candidate.numerical_contract: production row mapping, scale XOR pairing, packed-column order, four accumulator chains, FFMA order, warp reduction, weight-scale multiply, BF16 RNE boundary, residual/norm order, and SiLU order are unchanged
candidate.alignment_contract: test-only direct entry requires both packed-weight bases to be 16-byte aligned; production retains its existing 4-byte-aligned path

environment.claim_boundary: one same-binary process on one fixed-clock device

sass.candidate_pipeline_sequence: LDGSTS.E.BYPASS.128 -> LDGDEPBAR -> DEPBAR.LE -> CALL/WARPSYNC -> four cross-lane LDS -> CALL/WARPSYNC -> next LDGSTS
sass.compiler_observation: each source __syncwarp is outlined as CALL.REL to a WARPSYNC/RET helper; this dynamic control cost remains a separately bounded follow-up

performance_protocol.comparison: same-process and same-binary current production kernel versus test-only K256 packed-weight pipeline
performance_protocol.stop_loss: one-process failure stops replication, production integration, model oracle, end-to-end, Nsys, and NCU work

decision.reason: the canonical-layout pipeline is bit-exact and preserves four-CTA occupancy, but all actual and stress rounds regress by about seven percent
decision.closed_scope: K256 canonical-layout single-shared-slot cp.async with source-level __syncwarp consumers
decision.mechanism_interpretation: canonical global accesses were already coalesced; shared staging adds four LDS operations and two cross-lane synchronizations per K256 tile without reducing weight bytes or transactions, and ptxas outlines each synchronization through CALL/WARPSYNC/RET
decision.k512_decision: do not screen the higher-register K512 form after a 0.93x result; halving synchronization frequency cannot credibly meet the frozen 1.03x gate and risks spill from the 64-register ceiling

artifacts.role: full actual-checkpoint and stress hard-gate log

follow_up.next_priority: run one bounded K256 code-generation experiment replacing the two full-mask source __syncwarp calls with an inline full-mask warp barrier so the compiler cannot outline them; keep every other load, arithmetic, and test gate identical
follow_up.fallback_priority: if the inline barrier does not recover non-regression, prototype a Decode-only row-quad-interleaved packed-weight sidecar that removes cross-lane shared staging while canonical weights remain available for Prefill and 4-byte fallback
follow_up.do_not_restore: the measured canonical-layout K256 source-__syncwarp candidate, or a higher-register K512 variant, without materially different SASS

limitations: The result is from one fixed-clock Jetson AGX Orin and is not a cross-device claim.
Weights and block scales are exact layer-0 checkpoint slices; residual and norm inputs are deterministic BF16 fixtures rather than captured runtime activations.
The one-process stop-loss intentionally omitted five-process replication, full-model oracle, end-to-end timing, Nsys, and NCU.
The rejection closes the measured canonical-layout K256 implementation, not an interleaved Decode weight layout or a version whose SASS eliminates the observed synchronization calls.
